SELECT 
  market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'rsi14spot' as rsi,
  market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'macdtrail' as macd,
  market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'bbandspan' as bbands,
  market_sentiment_indicators -> 'momentum' ->> 'techmeter' as techmeter
FROM analyticsindicators LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'rsi14spot' as rsi14spot,
  market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'macdtrail' as macdtrail,
  market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'bbandspan' as bbandspan,
  market_sentiment_indicators -> 'momentum' ->> 'techmeter' as techmeter,
  ROUND(CAST(
    (ABS((market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'rsi14spot')::numeric - 50) 
     + ABS((market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'macdtrail')::numeric) 
     + ((market_sentiment_indicators -> 'oscillators' ->> 'bbandspan')::numeric * 0.01)) / 3.0 
     * CASE 
         WHEN market_sentiment_indicators -> 'momentum' ->> 'techmeter' = 'Buy' THEN 1
         WHEN market_sentiment_indicators -> 'momentum' ->> 'techmeter' = 'Sell' THEN -1
         ELSE 0
       END AS numeric), 4) as technical_signal_strength
FROM analyticsindicators
LIMIT 10;
